svg.title: MeloPresto button - canonical outline
svg.desc: Canonical MeloPresto button outline, elasticity 0, drawn at FW = 1000 units (fingertip width). Outer radius 0.29 FW, tip circles r = 0.08682 FW centred at (0, +/-0.26046 FW), joined along common tangents. Source: the outer master Assets/JiMS Button - Canonical.svg (the original JiMS-button.js and JiMS Button Geometry.md sources are retired); the Kernel's dt-geometry crate is the numeric authority.
